name: Introduction and overview — Panavia Tornado — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — Panavia Tornado
description: Introduction and overview of the Panavia Tornado: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The Panavia Tornado is a twin-engine multirole aircraft built by the Panavia consortium (UK, Germany, Italy), entering service in 1979. Its variable-sweep wings and terrain-following radar made it a superb low-level striker. About 990 were built in IDS strike, ADV interceptor, and ECR electronic-combat versions. Baseline facts: Twin-engine multirole aircraft; service from 1979; ~990 built by the Panavia consortium..
how_it_works: Wings generate lift from airflow; the engine provides thrust; control surfaces and fly-by-wire or mechanical controls steer the aircraft in three axes.
